paite: Issakar tapate: Tola, Puah, Jashub, Shimron, li ahi uh.
heading: Issakar Suante

paite: Tola tapate: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, Shemuel, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, huai bel, Tola a kipante; akhangte ua mihat hangsante: David dam lai in singnih sangnih-le-zaguk ahi uh.
Huan Uzzi tapa Izrahiah ahi, huan Izrahiah tapate: Mikael, Obadiah, Joel, Isshiah, nga ahi ua, avek un hausa makaipente ahi uh.
Amaute toh, apipute uh inkote dan in, akhangte un, kidouna ding a sepaih pawlte ahi ua, singthum-le-sangguk; zi leh tapa tampi anei uhi.
Huan Issakar inkote tengteng lak a, mihat hangsante, a-unaute uh avek ua khangthu sutna a sut in, singgiat-le-sangsagih ahi.
Benjamin tapate: Bela, Beker, Jediael, thum ahi uh.
heading: Benjamin Leh Dan Suante

paite: Bela tapate: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, Iri, nga ahi ua; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante; huan khangthu sutna a sim in singnih sangnih sawmthum-le-li ahi uh.
Beker, tapate: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, Alameth ahi uh. Hiaite tengteng Beker tapate ahi uh.
Huchi in khangthu sutna a sim ahi ua, akhangte uh dungzui in, apipute uh inkuan a lupente, mihat hangsante, singnih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Huan Jediael tapa Bilhan ahi; Bilhan tapate: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Kenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, Ahisahar.
Hiaite tengteng Jediael tapate ahi uh, apipute uh inkuan a lupente dungzui in, mihat hangsan, kidouna a dia sepaih pawl a kuankhe thei dingte, singkhat sangsagih-le-zanih ahi uh.
Ir tapate Shuppim leh Huppim ahi ua, Aher tapa Hushim ahi.
Naphtali tapate: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer leh Shallum, Bilhah tapate ahi uh.
heading: Naphtali Suante

paite: Manasseh tapate: Asriel, azi in asuan: amei Aram numei in Gilead pa Makir asuang hi;
heading: Manasseh Suante

paite: Makir in Huppim leh Shuppim sanggamnu amin Maakah zi in api a; anihna min Zelophehad ahi: Zelophehad in tanute anei hi.
Makir zi Maakah in tapa anei a, amin Peresh asa a; a-unaupa min Sheresh ahi; atapate Ulam leh Rakem ahi uh.
Ulam tapa Bedan ahi. Hiaite Gilead tapate ahi uh Makir tapa, Manasseh tapa.
Asanggamnu Hammoleketh in Ishod, Abiezer, Mahlah anei hi.
Shemida tapate Ahian, Shekem, Likhi, Aniam ahi uh.
Huan Ephraim tapate: Shuthelah, leh atapa Bered, leh atapa Tahath, leh atapa Eleadah, leh atapa Tahath,
heading: Ephraim Suante

paite: leh atapa Zabad, leh atapa Shuthelah, huan Ezer leh Elead, agante uh lamang ding a ahong paisuk ua gamsung a om Gath mite'n athahte uh.
Apa uh Ephraim in ni tampi asuun a, huchi in amah lungmuan ding in a-unaute ahong uhi.
Huchi in azi kiang ah ahoh a, nau apai a, tapa anei a, a-insung tuahsiat ziak in amin ding in Beriah asa hi.
Atanu Sheerah ahi a, Beth-horon nuainung leh tungnung leh Uzzen- sheerah lamnu ahi.
Rephah atapa ahi, Reseph leng; Reseph tapa Telah, Tahan atapa;
Laadan atapa, Ammihud atapa, Elishama atapa;
Nun atapa, Joshua atapa ahi.
Aneihte uleh atennate uh Bethel leh akhotate ahi, suahlam ah Naaran, tumlam ah Gezer, huai khopite toh, huai Ayyah leh khopite tan in.
Manasseh tate gamgi chin ah, Beth-shean leh akhopite, Taanak leh akhopite, Meggiddo leh akhopite, Dor leh akhopite, hiaite ah Israel tapa Joseph tapate ateng uhi.
Asher tapate: Imnah, Ishuah, Ishuai, Beriah, Sheerah asanggamnu uh.
heading: Asher Suante

paite: Beriah tapate: Heber, Malkiel, Birzaith pa.
Heber in Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, Shua asanggamnu asuang hi.
Japhlet tapate: Pasak, Bimhal, Asvath. Hiaite Japhlet tapate ahi uh.
Shamer tapate: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah leh Aram.
A-unaupa Helem tapate: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, Amal.
Zophah tapate: Suah, Hernephar, Shual, Beri, Imrah;
Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, Beera.
Jether tapate: Jephunneh, Pispah, Ara.
Ulla tapate: Arah, Hanniel, Rezia.
Hiaite tengteng Asher tate ahi uh; pipute inkuan a lupente, mihat, mitel, hangsan, kumpi tapate lak a vaihawmte. Kidouna nasepna ding a khangthu sutna a sim in amau zah singnih-le-sangguk ahi uhi.
